text.en:
Dealing sustained damage (TBD) spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8% Super Energy.

#e Spawned Orbs grant more Super Energy.

Scoring multiple hits against enemies spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8% Super Energy.

• Bows: 5 Hits
• Swords: 10? Hits

• Other: 67% of Magazine rounded down + 2 Hits
